Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a property tax exemption for the first fifty thousand dollars of assessed value of commercial and residential real property.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a property tax exemption for the first fiftythousand dollars of assessed value of commercial and residential realproperty; and adding a new section to chapter 84.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Residential property is exempt from the state portion of theproperty tax on fifty thousand dollars of assessed value. (2) A commercial property owner may apply to the county assessor toexempt fifty thousand dollars of assessed value for the state portionof the property tax for a single parcel of property. Application shallbe made on forms furnished by the county assessor and prescribed by thedepartment. A commercial property owner may not apply for an exemptionunder this section in more than one county. The department may adoptrules necessary to administer this section.
